title: ff7-web test scenario, formats 1 and 2
description: Format 1: a boot point, an input script on absolute frames, and assertions on named memory addresses and frame hashes. Format 2 (#37, #74): a named boot point (restored from a snapshot), a named snapshot kept by an earlier scenario in the same run, or power-on; an ordered script with waits and segments; and checks. Input segment files (harness/scenarios/segments/<name>.json) follow $defs/segment. See harness/README.md. Validated by runner/schema.js, which supports only the keywords used here.

format1.description: Format 1: a fixture or disc booted from power-on, an input script on absolute frames, and assertions on frames. Unchanged by format 2.

name.description: Unique scenario name; also the baseline file name (harness/baselines/<name>.json).

tier.description: 1: public, homebrew only; runner/scenario.js. 2: private eval (game data, run only by the trusted job); runner/tier2.js.

boot.description: Where the scenario starts, from power-on: a registered homebrew fixture, or (tier 2) a disc the private eval supplies. Save-state boot points are reserved for format 2.

disc.description: Disc name. The runner boots <name>.bin next to the --disc image, else the --disc image itself (no cue: a single data track). With no disc the scenario fails with "no disc".

frames.description: Emulated frames to run, counted from 1.

memory.description: Named main-RAM locations that assertions refer to.

input.description: Pad input script. Buttons are held during frames from..to (inclusive); overlapping steps on a port are OR-ed. Frames with no step hold nothing.

probes.description: Like assert, but a probe only feeds its metric: it never changes the status.

metrics.description: Numbers to report, at most 8. Each key is a built-in metric (frames, failed_assertions, run_ms, fps, boot_stage, disc_error; see runner/scenario.js), the name of a u8/u16/u32 memory location read at the end of the last frame, or the metric an assertion or probe names. A Tier 2 run reports only these keys, and only as numbers (harness/schema/tier2-result.schema.json).

checkpoints.description: Frames whose hashes are compared with harness/baselines/<name>.json when that file exists, and recorded by --record.

format2.description: Format 2 (#37, #74): start from a named boot point (runner/bootpoints.js), a named snapshot kept by an earlier scenario in the same run, or power-on; play an ordered script of presses, waits and segments; then check memory conditions and state equality. No raw RAM, picture or hash is reported.

name.description: Unique scenario name; also the baseline file name (harness/baselines/<name>.json).

tier.description: 1: public, homebrew only; runner/scenario.js. 2: private eval (game data, run only by the trusted job); runner/tier2.js.

boot.description: Where the script starts. With a source (disc or fixture), "from" is a boot point in runner/bootpoints.js that boots the same source, or "power-on". With no source, "from" names a snapshot that an earlier scenario in the same run kept (its "snapshot"), and the source is that chain's; if no such snapshot exists (yet), the scenario does not run and reports "no snapshot" (#74).

disc.description: Disc number. The runner boots disc-<N>.bin next to the --disc image, else the --disc image. With no disc the scenario fails with "no disc".

oneOf.description: A named snapshot kept by an earlier scenario in the same run (#74). Snapshots live in memory for one run only.

A boot from a generated save (#38): the boot point "from" (default "title-card", disc 1's title screen with a memory card in slot 1), with its blank card replaced, as the snapshot is restored, by a card generated inside the run from the save description harness/saves/<save>.json and the New Game data on the disc (runner/savegen/). The card is held in memory only and never written to a file (docs/SECURITY.md, "Generated save boot points"). The script then loads the save by input.

from.description: A boot point with a memory card (card "blank" in runner/bootpoints.js). Default "title-card".

slot.description: The memory card slot that holds the card; the runner has slot 1 only.

checksum.description: "right" (default), or "wrong": the savemap checksum is stored inverted, to check that the game rejects the save.

memory.description: Named main-RAM locations that assertions refer to.

input.description: The script: presses, waits and segments, in order. Segments are expanded before the run, to at most 16384 steps. Frames with no press hold nothing.

metrics.description: Numbers to report, at most 8: a built-in (frames, failed_assertions, run_ms, fps, boot_stage, disc_error, snapshot_frames, saved_ms; see runner/format2.js), a u8/u16/u32 memory name read at the end of the script, or the metric a wait or a check names.

snapshot.description: Keep the state at the end of the script in memory under this name, for later scenarios in the same run (boot: { from: NAME }). Kept only when the scenario passes; a later scenario that keeps the same name replaces it. Never written to a file; discarded at the end of the run (#74).

discPath.description: A file on the disc, e.g. MENU/SAVEMENU.MNU (case-insensitive, no ;1), or SYSTEM.CNF:BOOT for the executable that SYSTEM.CNF boots.

address.description: PS1 main-RAM address (KUSEG, KSEG0 or KSEG1), as a hex string.

value.description: An integer, a hex string (u8/u16/u32), or a hex byte string in memory order (bytes).

oneOf.description: A named memory location equals a value at the end of a frame.
A frame's hash equals or differs from another frame's hash in the same run.

discFile.description: A disc file's SHA-1 equals a value (disc boot only). Reported only as pass or fail, never as the hash. metric: 1 when it matches, else 0.

withinEquals.description: A named memory location equals a value at the end of some frame from 1 to within. metric: the first such frame, 0 if none.

withinDiscBytes.description: A named bytes location equals its len bytes of a disc file from offset, at the end of some frame from 1 to within (disc boot only). The disc bytes are never reported. metric: the first such frame, 0 if none.

withinStill.description: The picture stays the same, and is not a single colour, for stillFrames consecutive frames, the first of them at or before within. metric: that first frame, 0 if none.

probe.description: A disc file check or a within condition that must name its metric.

bootPointName.description: A boot point in runner/bootpoints.js, or "power-on".

snapshotName.description: A named snapshot (#74). Not a boot point name and not "power-on" (checked by the loader).

saveName.description: A save description: harness/saves/<name>.json, matching harness/schema/save.schema.json (#32, #38).

markName.description: A mark step's name (#38), unique within a script.

segmentName.description: An input segment: segments/<name>.json beside the scenario file (harness/scenarios/segments/).

press.description: Buttons pressed while a wait runs (#74): held for `hold` frames (default 1, less than `every`) at the start of every `every` frames, from the wait's first frame.

segment.description: An input segment file (#74), segments/<name>.json beside the scenario files. Its steps are format 2 script steps and may include other segments, but not recursively. Conditions refer to the including scenario's memory names, and metrics the steps name must be listed by that scenario.

name.description: Must equal the file name without .json.

scriptStep.description: One step of a format 2 script. Steps run in order; frames are counted from 1 after the start point.

oneOf.description: Hold buttons for `frames` frames (default 1), then go on. Nothing else is held meanwhile.
Hold nothing for a fixed number of frames.

Hold nothing (or the wait's `press`) until a memory condition holds at the end of a frame, for at most `timeout` frames. If it never holds, the scenario fails and the script stops there. metric: the frames waited (1 if it held at the end of the first frame), 0 on a timeout.

Hold nothing (or the wait's `press`) until the picture has stayed the same, and not a single colour, for `stillFrames` consecutive frames, for at most `timeout` frames (#74). If it never does, the scenario fails and the script stops there. metric: the frames waited until it held (at least stillFrames), 0 on a timeout.
Include an input segment's steps here (#74). Expanded before the run; a missing or recursive segment is a load error.
Record the value of every u8/u16/u32 memory location at this point (#38), for change checks with "since". Takes no frames; nothing leaves the run.

condition.description: A named u8/u16/u32 memory location equals a value, differs from it, or lies in an inclusive range [low, high]. Compared inside the run; only pass/fail leaves.

check2.description: A format 2 check, made at the end of the script.

oneOf.description: A memory condition at the end of the script. metric: 1 if it holds, else 0.

A named u8/u16/u32 memory location at the end of the script compared with its value at the start of the script (#77), or with "since" at the script's mark step of that name (#38): "increased", "decreased", "unchanged" or "changed". signed: compare as two's complement (s8/s16/s32). Compared inside the run; neither value leaves. metric: the sign of end - start (-1, 0 or 1), whether or not the check passes; 0 if the run stopped or a wait timed out.

since.description: Compare with the value at this mark step instead of the start of the script. If the script did not reach the mark, the check fails and its metric is 0.

oneOf.description: The script is played again and must end in the same state (main RAM and picture, compared by hash inside the run): "rerun" from the same start point, "boot" after a fresh boot through the boot point with no snapshot. metric: 1 if the states match, else 0.
